scripts.dev: npm run gen && wrangler dev --env paper --test-scheduled
scripts.db:migrate:paper: wrangler d1 migrations apply trade-bot-paper --env paper --remote
scripts.db:migrate:live: wrangler d1 migrations apply trade-bot-live --env live --remote
scripts.deploy:paper: npm run gen && wrangler deploy --env paper
scripts.deploy:live: npm run gen && wrangler deploy --env live
